# fishtraitR

[![docs
(main)](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-fishtraitR-orange.svg?colorB=E91E63)](https://fish-trait-network.github.io/fishtraitR/)

Access imputed trait values and predictive variance for fishes, as
Distribution stage for the fish-trait-network

### Example

\
`# Install`\
`pak``::`[`pak`](https://pak.r-lib.org/reference/pak.html)`(``"fish-trait-network/fishtraitR"``)`\
[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`"fishtraitR"`](https://fish-trait-network.github.io/fishtraitR/)`)`\
\
`# Download database from Zenodo`\
[`download_traits`](https://fish-trait-network.github.io/fishtraitR/dev/reference/download_traits.md)`(``)`\
\
`# Access traits`\
[`get_traits`](https://fish-trait-network.github.io/fishtraitR/dev/reference/get_traits.md)`(``"Aapticheilichthys websteri"``)`

# Package index

## Accessing traits

Access trait estimates and predictive uncertainty.

- [`download_traits()`](https://fish-trait-network.github.io/fishtraitR/dev/reference/download_traits.md)
  : Download a release of trait predictions
- [`get_traits()`](https://fish-trait-network.github.io/fishtraitR/dev/reference/get_traits.md)
  : Get predicted traits and covariances

## Plot output

Visualize output

- [`plot(`*`<get_traits>`*`)`](https://fish-trait-network.github.io/fishtraitR/dev/reference/plot.get_traits.md)
  : Plot predicted traits and covariances

## Derived quantities

Calcualte derived quantities.

- [`get_r()`](https://fish-trait-network.github.io/fishtraitR/dev/reference/get_r.md)
  : Calculate intrinsic growth rate, generation time, and steepness
